title: Sayed Shohag Rahman - Marketing Manager | Pav Dental Team

blocks.text: Sayed oversees Pav Dental’s communications, website, seo and community outreach. He makes booking simple, keeps patients informed about offers and late-opening slots, and ensures our messages are clear and accessible
